name: Active Scanning
description: Probing victim infrastructure with network traffic to learn what exists and what is reachable.

name: Gather Victim Host Information
description: Collecting details about victim hosts such as operating systems, software and configuration.

name: Gather Victim Network Information
description: Collecting details about victim networks such as address ranges and topology.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Using the credentials of an existing account to gain or keep access.

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Exploiting a weakness in an Internet-facing service to gain a foothold.

name: External Remote Services
description: Using remote access services exposed to the Internet, such as VPN or RDP, to enter a network.

name: Phishing
description: Sending deceptive messages to trick users into running malware or giving up credentials.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Running commands or scripts through shells and interpreters available on the host.

name: User Execution
description: Relying on a user to open a file or link that starts malicious code.

name: Scheduled Task/Job
description: Abusing task schedulers to run code repeatedly or at boot.

name: Create Account
description: Creating a new account to keep access to systems.

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
description: Exploiting a software flaw to gain higher privileges.

name: Indicator Removal
description: Deleting or altering logs and artefacts to hide activity.

name: Brute Force
description: Guessing passwords or keys systematically when credentials are not known.

name: OS Credential Dumping
description: Extracting account credentials from the operating system or its memory.

name: Adversary-in-the-Middle
description: Positioning between parties to intercept or alter traffic and capture credentials.

name: Network Service Discovery
description: Enumerating services running on remote hosts to find ones that can be attacked.

name: Remote System Discovery
description: Listing other systems on the network to plan further movement.

name: Network Sniffing
description: Capturing network traffic to obtain information or credentials.

name: Remote Services
description: Logging into services built for remote access, such as SSH, RDP and SMB, using valid credentials.

name: Lateral Tool Transfer
description: Copying tools or files between systems inside the victim network.

name: Data from Local System
description: Gathering files and data from a compromised host.

name: Data from Network Shared Drive
description: Collecting data from shared network drives reachable from a compromised host.

name: Application Layer Protocol: DNS
description: Carrying command traffic or data inside DNS to blend in with normal activity.

name: Non-Standard Port
description: Using a protocol on an unexpected port to evade filtering or inspection.

name: Proxy
description: Relaying traffic through intermediate systems to hide the true destination.

name: Protocol Tunneling
description: Encapsulating one protocol inside another to hide or bypass controls.

name: Encrypted Channel
description: Encrypting command traffic so its contents cannot be inspected.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Sending stolen data over the same channel used for command and control.

name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
description: Sending stolen data over a protocol different from the main command channel.

name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
description: Uploading stolen data to an external web service.

name: Network Denial of Service
description: Degrading availability by overwhelming network resources.

name: Data Encrypted for Impact
description: Encrypting data to interrupt availability, commonly for extortion.
